2607.sigma:
title: n8n-MCP Destructive Workflow Version Backup Operation (CVE-2026-54052)
id: b3e1c7a2-4f8d-4a1e-9c3b-7d2e5f0a9c14
status: experimental
description: Detects invocation of the n8n-mcp n8n_workflow_versions tool in a destructive mode (delete/prune/truncate), the impact path of CVE-2026-54052 cross-tenant backup destruction in multi-tenant HTTP deployments.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j6r7-6fhx-77wx
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/15
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1565.001
  - attack.t1485
logsource:
  product: n8n_mcp
  service: application
detection:
  selection_tool:
    message|contains: 'n8n_workflow_versions'
  selection_mode:
    message|contains:
      - '"mode":"delete"'
      - '"mode":"prune"'
      - '"mode":"truncate"'
  condition: selection_tool and selection_mode
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate version-retention pruning
  - The 2.56.1 upgrade migration that clears un-scoped backups
level: high
2607.spl:
index=* (sourcetype="n8n-mcp" OR sourcetype="n8n_mcp" OR source="*n8n-mcp*" OR source="*n8n_mcp*") "n8n_workflow_versions" ("\"mode\":\"delete\"" OR "\"mode\":\"prune\"" OR "\"mode\":\"truncate\"" OR "mode=delete" OR "mode=prune" OR "mode=truncate")
| rex field=_raw "(?i)workflow[_\-]?id[\"':=\s]+(?<workflow_id>[A-Za-z0-9]{6,})"
| rex field=_raw "(?i)tenant[_\-]?id[\"':=\s]+(?<tenant_id>[A-Za-z0-9\-]{3,})"
| table _time, host, source, tenant_id, workflow_id, _raw
| sort - _time

2608.sent:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where SyslogMessage has "n8n-mcp" or SyslogMessage has "n8n_mcp"
| where SyslogMessage has "ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT" and SyslogMessage has_any ("true","enabled")
| extend Version = extract(@'(?i)n8n[_\-]?mcp[^0-9]{0,20}v?(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', 1, SyslogMessage)
| extend Mitigated = iif(SyslogMessage matches regex @'(?i)DISABLED_TOOLS\S*n8n_workflow_versions', true, false)
| extend Parts = split(Version, ".")
| extend VulnVersion = iif(isnotempty(Version) and (toint(Parts[0]) < 2 or (toint(Parts[0]) == 2 and (toint(Parts[1]) < 56 or (toint(Parts[1]) == 56 and toint(Parts[2]) <= 0)))), true, false)
| where Mitigated == false and (VulnVersion == true or isempty(Version))
| summarize Version = any(Version), Sample = any(SyslogMessage), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, HostName, ProcessName
| order by LastSeen desc
2608.spl:
index=* (sourcetype="n8n-mcp" OR sourcetype="n8n_mcp" OR source="*n8n-mcp*" OR source="*n8n_mcp*") "ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT" ("true" OR "enabled")
| rex field=_raw "(?i)n8n[_\-]?mcp[^0-9]{0,20}v?(?<ver>\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"
| eval mitigated=if(match(_raw,"(?i)DISABLED_TOOLS\S*n8n_workflow_versions"),1,0)
| eval vuln_version=if(isnotnull(ver) AND (tonumber(mvindex(split(ver,"."),0))<2 OR (tonumber(mvindex(split(ver,"."),0))==2 AND (tonumber(mvindex(split(ver,"."),1))<56 OR (tonumber(mvindex(split(ver,"."),1))==56 AND tonumber(mvindex(split(ver,"."),2))<=0)))),1,0)
| where mitigated=0 AND (vuln_version=1 OR isnull(ver))
| stats latest(ver) as version, latest(_raw) as sample, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by host, source
| sort - last_seen

2694.def:

// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("react-html2pdf.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("react-html2pdf.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2694.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — What is a dependency firewall? ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("react-html2pdf.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count

    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2748.sigma:
title: TSDProxy Internal Auth Token Replay to Management API
id: a1f4c2e0-8b3d-4c6a-9e21-7f0d5b3a9c11
description: Detects a process injecting the tsdproxy internal secret header (x-tsdproxy-auth-token) with a spoofed x-tsdproxy-id against the 127.0.0.1:8080 management API (GHSA-g936-7jqj-mwv8).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-g936-7jqj-mwv8
  - https://advisories.gitlab.com/golang/github.com/almeidapaulopt/tsdproxy/GHSA-g936-7jqj-mwv8/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/12
tags:
  - attack.t1550.001
  - attack.t1068
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  token:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'x-tsdproxy-auth-token'
      - 'x-tsdproxy-id'
  target:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '127.0.0.1:8080'
      - 'localhost:8080'
      - '/api/v1/'
  condition: token and target
level: high
2748.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process="*x-tsdproxy-auth-token*" OR Processes.process="*x-tsdproxy-id*") (Processes.process="*127.0.0.1:8080*" OR Processes.process="*localhost:8080*" OR Processes.process="*/api/v1/*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
